exact.method: Actual sorted GPU gather IDs copied to the host in a diagnostic run; each layer invocation has a separate union. Histogram preserves per-call (input rows, distinct rows) counts; no chronology inferred.

input_quantization.method: Each full-prompt layer/chunk invocation has at most chunk_tokens distinct input rows. Account for repeated requests via the GLU-decision call count. Routed MMQ input rows above this bound prove repeated quantization. See exact when gather IDs were captured.

scope: Working-fork host dispatch capture, 600/8192 prompts, two requests each, 16 outputs. Phase 0 setup/calibration; phase 1 prefill; phase 2 decode. T2-8 here are expert prefill batches, not an enabled speculative verifier. No timings/DRAM bandwidth inferred from counters.
limitation: Additional diagnostic gather-ID copy/synchronization can perturb routing plans and timing. Not pooled with previous diagnostic population or clean timings.
